acceptanceCriteria.statement: With the Rocky preset at distance 4, dialing uProvinceWeight 0→1 produces large-scale distinct areas: mountains and craters cluster into different regions instead of tiling the globe evenly. Pixel change ≥3% on the planet disk and the regional dichotomy is visible in before/after screenshots.

verifyVia.input: Lab on :9223, Rocky preset, d4, clouds zeroed; set uniforms.uProvinceWeight.value 0 then 1; screenshot both
verifyVia.observable: Pixel-diff ≥3% (gray levels >8) between the pair; ON shot shows smooth-vs-rough regional separation comparable to spike shots stageD-spike-rocky-03/04

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Province weights are soft continuous fields — no hard borders. The JS oracle mirror of provinceWeight() has bounded local variation (no step discontinuity) and stays within [floor, 1].

verifyVia.input: npx vitest run tests/planet-archetypes.test.js — provinceWeight oracle: sample along great-circle paths with small step, assert max |Δw| per step below smoothness bound and range within [floor, 1]
verifyVia.observable: New vitest oracle tests pass; suite green

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Every built feature (F1-F11, F17, F18, F22, F23 + lava cracks) has a province affinity entry {field, polarity, floor}, mirrored as data in planet-archetypes.js, and at least two features resolve to complementary regions (feature-poor provinces).

verifyVia.input: vitest: affinity table covers every registered built FEATURES id; complementarity check on at least one pair (e.g. mountains vs craters polarity)

acceptanceCriteria.statement: No combiner signature changes: Stage-D lands by swapping the reserved scalar for the spatial accessor; combiner bodies multiply by provinceWeight(FEATURE_ID). The uSpikeProvince spike toggle is removed (subsumed).

verifyVia.input: git diff of the Stage-D commit(s) over planet-lod-lab.html
verifyVia.observable: Combiner function signatures unchanged; uSpikeProvince and spikeProvinceField absent from the file; provinceWeight() accessor present and read by all built combiners

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The F08 ad-hoc province mask inside lavaCrackEmissive is replaced by the shared field — no second divergent province mechanism — and the lava-crack glow still clusters into scattered centers (the Io read Max accepted in fix cycle 1) rather than a globe-tiling net.

verifyVia.input: Static: the ad-hoc pn-noise province term is gone from lavaCrackEmissive. Live: Lava preset nightside d4, activity raised, screenshot
verifyVia.observable: Glow appears as clustered centers following the shared field; no uniform net

acceptanceCriteria.statement: With uProvinceWeight = 0 the legacy Phase-3 look is intact — the 15 Phase-3 verdicts remain the regression baseline. Spot-check, not full re-judging.

verifyVia.input: Lab on :9223: for Rocky, Lava, Europa presets at d4 (clouds zeroed), set uProvinceWeight=0, screenshot; compare against Phase-3 reference shots
verifyVia.observable: No structural change vs Phase-3 baseline (allowing the known ~0.0003% terrain fizz); vitest 8/8 stays green; backtick parity stays even

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Walking the preset gallery, planets read as bodies with distinct geologic regions — the Moon maria-vs-highlands / Mars dichotomy feel Max described — rather than slop laid over slop.

verifyVia.input: Max walks the preset gallery in the lab with provinces live
